cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I raised my hand when you did. Yes, I'll host Christmas; that vote makes me chair of the meal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking for more tea. We agreed everyone supplies one dish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, contributions. Hosting counts as mine, so I don't owe a dish.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cook the turkey at yours, but you'll need to clear the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll clear it, then. But that's hosting; don't count me twice and put me on peeling as well.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 imitates a raised hand as a vote; B2 exposes tea request and a dish rule. A3 uses hosting to claim exemption and A5 divides kitchen work protectively.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 one-dish rule causes A3 hosting contribution; B4 turkey offer causes A5 clearing agreement with no peeling.

relationship.evidence: B4 offers to do the cooking, a cooperative solution which A can accept while protecting an exemption.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 help to define the edge of hosting rather than simply refusing.
